title: AI safety and human oversight
description: Make AI useful without losing privacy or human control.
questions: How can an agent complete a task while sharing only the information its recipient needs?
How can it communicate uncertainty, expose unreliable reasoning and know when to ask a person?

title: Agents and system evaluation
description: Improve the whole system, from planning and tool use to coordination between agents.
questions: When an agent fails, was the cause its plan, a tool, retrieved evidence or communication with another agent?
How can we compare systems and check their reasoning and actions with reproducible evaluations?

title: Memory and continual adaptation
description: Help agents learn from new information and user corrections without retraining for every update.
questions: How should an agent update or delete a memory and revise the facts that depend on it?
How can it recognise that a previously known answer has become unknown, rather than repeat an outdated fact?

title: Retrieval and grounded reasoning
description: Connect models to relevant, current evidence across text and images.
questions: When should a model rely on its parameters, and when should it search or use external knowledge?
How can it resolve conflicting evidence and distinguish a correct match from a plausible half-truth?
